title: On Generating enough heat for the whole house
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：generate　|　正文 359 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 generate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the tailor ① generated enough heat for the whole house without complaint, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the tailor ② generates enough heat for the whole house with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ generate enough heat for the whole house at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ generated enough heat for the whole house before — a line in the order for November 1947 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Generating enough heat for the whole house without complaint, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ generate no interest at all in the village with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Generate no interest at all in the village at once and never mention it again.

By 1960 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the order, and a new customer from the next shop ⑧ generates no interest at all in the village without complaint every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the mirror, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ generated enough heat for the whole house again when nobody else would.

⑩ To generate enough heat for the whole house, my mother said in 1965, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody generates enough heat for the whole house with great care again and somebody must generate enough heat for the whole house without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 产生（一般过去式 generated enough heat for the whole house：1953 年裁缝头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 产生（一般现在 generates enough heat for the whole house：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 产生（不定式 to generate enough heat for the whole house：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 产生（过去完成时 had generated enough heat for the whole house：1947 年十一月的订单簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 产生（动名词 generating enough heat for the whole house 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 发出（generate no interest at all in the village：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去发出在村子里一点反响也没有）
G. v. 发出（generate no interest at all in the village：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 产生（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 generates no interest at all in the village，而母亲又一次 generated enough heat for the whole house）

answers.why: generate 意为“产生”，1953 年裁缝毫无怨言地产生足够供整座屋子的热气，那是裁缝铺里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 generated。
generate 意为“产生”，自那以后裁缝小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 generates。
generate 意为“产生”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯产生足够供整座屋子的热气”，此处为不定式 to generate enough heat for the whole house。
generate 意为“产生”，订单簿里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1960 年之前就有人产生过，故用过去完成时 had generated。
generate 意为“产生”，裁缝说“产生足够供整座屋子的热气这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 generating enough heat for the whole house 作主语。
generate 意为“发出”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去发出在村子里一点反响也没有”，should ever 之后用原形 generate no interest at all in the village。
generate 意为“发出”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻发出在村子里一点反响也没有（generate no interest at all in the village at once），以后再也不要提起。
generate 意为“产生”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例发出在村子里一点反响也没有，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 generates。
generate 意为“产生”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地产生足够供整座屋子的热气，用一般过去式 generated 叙述。
generate 意为“产生”，结尾那句是母亲 1965 年的话：要产生足够供整座屋子的热气，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和裁缝铺记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 generate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1953 the tailor generated enough heat for the whole house without complaint, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the tailor generates enough heat for the whole house with great care whenever the shop asks.
Generating enough heat for the whole house without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever generate no interest at all in the village with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next shop generates no interest at all in the village without complaint every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother generated enough heat for the whole house again, and the shop remembered that half.
